goal: Extract HDFS-directory reservation behavior while preserving the existing public Utils reservation methods.

ops.details: Move the implementations of getSortedSetFromFile(org.apache.accumulo.manager.Manager, org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path, boolean), getSortedSplitsFromFile(org.apache.accumulo.server.ServerContext, org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path), reserveHdfsDirectory(org.apache.accumulo.manager.Manager, java.lang.String, org.apache.accumulo.core.fate.FateId), and unreserveHdfsDirectory(org.apache.accumulo.manager.Manager, java.lang.String, org.apache.accumulo.core.fate.FateId) into UtilsHdfsReservation, retaining public Utils methods with their existing signatures as compatibility wrappers. The HDFS reservation methods remove Utils's direct references to java.util.Base64 and org.apache.accumulo.core.fate.zookeeper.ZooReservation. The extracted file-parser methods retain their existing delegation to org.apache.accumulo.manager.tableOps.UtilsFileParser; therefore UtilsFileParser is not claimed as removed. The target gains only UtilsHdfsReservation, so the expected net Fan-Out reduction from this block is two removed dependencies minus one introduced dependency, or one. java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets remains required by getNextId in Utils.

outputs: Updated imports for the extracted HDFS reservation responsibility and compatibility wrappers
ops.details: Remove Base64 and ZooReservation imports from Utils after all direct calls are moved, add the UtilsHdfsReservation reference, and retain imports still required by the unchanged public signatures and remaining methods.
